object:checkered / chain lightning.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a closed book lying diagonally, with a tan-olive cover with faint square check pattern and thick pale pages. Its pale page block is visible at lower left; the teal floor is background.
object:checkered / chain lightning.wikiDescription: The wiki documents the spellbook of chain lightning as teaching that spell, while its article treats the feature as upcoming for another NetHack branch. This local NetHack 5 atlas has a checkered appearance slot; the cover alone never proves the spell identity.
object:checkered / chain lightning.modelBrief: Build the shared thick closed-book form lying diagonally, with cream page block and tan checkered cover with quiet square pattern. Keep its appearance separate from its shuffled spell identity.

sources.label: NetHack Wiki: Spellbook of chain lightning

object:plain / blank paper.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a closed book lying diagonally, with a plain two-tone brown cover with no writing or ornament. Its pale page block is visible at lower left; the teal floor is background.
object:plain / blank paper.wikiDescription: The wiki describes blank spellbooks as writable books from which a new spellbook can be made with a magic marker. The plain cover gives no spell identity.
object:plain / blank paper.modelBrief: Build a closed book with unadorned brown cover and clean page block. Leave the cover free of spell markings and keep the pages clean.

sources.label: NetHack Wiki: Spellbook of blank paper
